scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api "npm run dev -w @enzo/web" "npm run dev -w @enzo/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @enzo/domain && npm run build -w @enzo/catalog && npm run build -w @enzo/api && npm run build -w @enzo/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @enzo/domain && npm run build -w @enzo/catalog && npm run typecheck -w @enzo/api
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
